notes: Both attestations (Isa.18.2, 18.7) are the identical clause "whose land the rivers have divided" -- KJV renders this "spoiled", but the lexicon's own definition ("probably to cleave") supports "divide" reasonably (rivers cleaving/cutting through the land). Isa.18.2 kept as citation per the usual duplicate-slot tie-break.
Gloss collision: "divide" (exact) matches SEVEN existing root-level glosses -- חצה, חצץ, פרד, בדל, חלק, and a clause each of גזר and פלג -- disambiguating search alias added.
